articles.title: Crypto advocacy groups oppose Illinois digital asset tax in court
articles.snippet: Following a similar lawsuit filed by the Digital Chamber in July, two digital asset advocacy groups challenged Illinois’ 0.2% crypto tax on constitutional and due process grounds.

articles.title: Nearly 2,000 Hacked WordPress Sites Turned Into Criminal Infrastructure
articles.snippet: The StopAndProtect operation used compromised WordPress websites to spread malware, steal crypto wallet files, and deploy ransomware.
